source: Freeport-McMoRan Tyrone Inc. 2024 Emma Part 4 Exploration Permit Application, Attachment A
source_fields: Drillhole ID; Longitude (WGS84); Latitude (WGS84); Easting; Northing
local_coordinate_interpretation: Tyrone Mine local grid in feet; east positive, west negative; north positive. Corroborated by 2021 Emma well logs explicitly naming the Tyrone Mine coordinate system.

validation.method: fit 2D similarity transform on four spatially distributed controls; hold out remaining 30
validation.acceptance_context: Residuals are far below the 10 m raster pixel scale. No depth values were used to fit or select the transform.

final_fit.method: 2D similarity transform refit to all 34 official coordinate pairs after validation passed

independent_sanity_check.reference: FCX published Tyrone Tailing Dam 3X location 32°43'13.94N, 108°24'51.07W
independent_sanity_check.result: Falls inside the Dam 3X local drawing-grid extent and in the expected relative location; used only as a sanity check, not as fitting data.

limitations: This validates the grid-to-global transform, not original CAD/survey plot vertices.
Six plot boundaries remain digitized from the official AS-BUILT drawing centerlines.
Do not use the transform to revive or retune the failed NB numerical-depth formula.
